method: two-sided two-proportion z test, normal approximation, alpha=0.05, power=0.80
note: Per arm. n=50 gives power 0.74 for 0.50 vs 0.25 (0.59 for 0.40 vs 0.20); n=60 gives 0.82 and 0.67. A floor of 50 is below the 58 needed for 80% power at the 0.50 vs 0.25 effect, so 50 is only justified if the owner accepts ~74% power.
